title: Director Of Business Development - Sap
description:
About GyanSysGyanSys is a leading mid-tier systems integrator supporting global enterprise customers. As a recognized innovator in digital and process transformation, we specialize in SAP and Salesforce implementations, managed services, and analytics. We integrate cutting edge solutions in complex multi-cloud environments to optimize operations and to maximize return on investment. With over 2000 consultants, we are headquartered in Indianapolis USA, with delivery centers in Bangalore, India and Manila, Philippines.Position Overview:
We are looking for an SAP Business Development Director with an entrepreneur mindset. Excellent opportunity to join an established global consultancy expanding their presence across Latin America.To plan and carry out sales activities and identify new clients, to build and develop sales of SAP Services to medium and large corporations. To develop relations specifically within the SAP market in the region and work closely with our Managing Director LATAM and global SAP Experts to deliver Projects and Managed Services with an Offshore or Hybrid delivery model.Traditional consulting sales teams focus on understanding client needs and positioning offerings as solutions. Typical outputs include well-crafted proposals and statements of work (SOW). GyanSys fundamentally differs;
outside of identifyingneeds and solutions, we attempt to redefine needs and possibilities, inspiring organizations to drive change.The individuals at GyanSys who thrive in this role are deep technology generalists (a strong understanding of SaaS, PaaS, CRM, etc), coaches who advocate for their clients, focusing on building long-lasting relationships. With an ingrained sense of curiosity, they put the team ahead of themselves and are driven to have a huge impact on the results of the company and their clients.You will expand GyanSys' relationships with SAP by engaging directly with their enterprise sales teams.Key responsibilities and accountabilities:
- Building and Developing relations within the SAP market in the region- Plan and carry responsibility of new logo acquisition and responsible for new business.- Responsible for building pipeline and follow up sales leads- Develop ideas and create offers and value propositions, work closely with our global Experts- Work on large deals/ hunting and bid process for the targeted customer- Execute internal/external Marketing activities and research required for business development- Travel for sales activates and build personal relationship with prospects and customersWhat you bring to be successful:
- 10+ years’ experience in selling Consultancy Services and Solutions for SAP- Experienced as Hunters / Farmers for Mid - Enterprise customers- Existing relationships with IT Directors / C-level Executives- Know-how and ability to offer Offshore & Hybrid delivery Models- Business fluent in Spanish and English.

description:

At Johnson & Johnson,we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build aworld where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured,where treatments are smarter and less invasive, andsolutions are personal.Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity.Learn more at FunctionR&D OperationsJob Sub FunctionClinical Trial SupportJob CategoryProfessionalAll Job Posting Locations:
São Paulo, BrazilJob DescriptionOur expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.Learn more at:
are searching for the best talents for these 6 positions of Senior Site Manager (home based).Purpose:
A Senior, Site Manager is a mid-level site management role with typically 3-5 years of experience. This role serves as the primary contact point between the Sponsor and the Investigational Site. A Senior, Site Manager is assigned to trial sites to ensure inspection readiness through compliance with the clinical trial protocol, company Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and applicable regulations and guidelines from study start-up through to site closure. Responsibilities may include assisting with site selection, site qualification assessment, subject recruitment and retention planning, site initiation, on-site and remote monitoring and close-out activities. The Senior, Site Manager will partner with the Local Trial Manager (LTM), Clinical Trial Assistant (CTA) and TDL (Trial Delivery Leader) to ensure overall site management while performing trial related activities for assigned protocols. A Senior, Site Manager may contribute to process improvement, training and mentoring of other Site Managers. A Senior, Site Manager is generally expected to be able to operate independently with little or limited supervision.Principal Responsibilities1 Acts as primary local company contact for assigned sites for specific trials.2 Actively May participate in site feasibility and/or Site Qualification Visit.3 Attends/participates in investigator meetings as needed, may be expected to help prepare meeting materials and may be required to present at the IM.4 Responsible for executing activities within site initiation and start-up, preparation and conduct of site monitoring (including remote monitoring), site management (by study specific systems and other reports/dashboards) and site/study close-out according to SOPs, Work Instructions (WIs) and policies. Responsible for the implementation of analytical risk-based monitoring model at the site level and to work with site to ensure timely resolution of issues found during monitoring visits. Able to implement and execute all tasks independently with little or limited supervision.5 Ensures site staff are trained and the corresponding training records are complete and accurate at any time point during all trial phases. Responsible in close collaboration with LTM and central study team for the activities during site activation phase in order to speed up the process and activate the site in shortest possible timeframe. May be required to help provide solutions to challenges faced in other sites in the country.6 Contributes to site level recruitment strategy and contingency planning and implementation in partnership with other functional areas.7 Ensures site study supplies (such as Non-Investigational Product (IP), lab kits, etc.) are adequate for trial conduct.8 Ensures that clinical drug supplies are appropriately used, handled and stored and returns are accurately inventoried and documented.9 Arranges for the appropriate destruction of clinical supplies.10 Ensures site staff complete data entry and resolve queries within expected timelines.11 Ensures accuracy, validity and completeness of data collected at trial sites12 Proactively ensures that all Adverse Events (AE)/Serious Adverse Events (SAEs)/Product Quality Complaints (PQCs) are reported within the required reporting timelines and documented as appropriate. For AEs/SAEs, ensures that they are consistent with all data collected and with the information in the source documents.13 Maintains complete, accurate and timely data and essential documents in relevant systems utilized for trial management.14 Fully documents trial related activities, in particular monitoring. Writes visit reports and follow-up letter in accordance with the SOPs. Promptly communicates relevant status information and issues to appropriate stakeholders.15 Reviews study files for completeness and ensures archiving retention requirements are met, including storage in a secure area at all times.16 Collaborates with LTM for documenting and communicating site/study progress and issues to trial central team.17 Attends regularly scheduled team meetings and trainings.18 Complies with relevant training requirements. Act as local expert in assigned protocols. Possesses proficient therapeutic knowledge sufficient to support role and responsibilities.19 Works closely with LTM to ensure Corrective Action Preventative Action (CAPA) is completed for Quality Assurance (QA) site audits and for quality issues identified at the site during routine monitoring and other visit types, e.G. description:

The position will work and partner with multiple teams to develop and execute category sourcing strategies and processes, deliver savings and improve productivity.Key job responsibilities- Build and create a 3PL EF procurement team creating 3PL solutions solving for network capacity- Build a resilient 3PL supplier ecosystem creating resiliency, flexibility, and incremental capacity when required- Identify, develop and deliver long term sourcing strategies while leading sourcing initiatives with cross-functional teams- Drive the decision-making process with senior leadership to improve 3PL EF category management.- Drive commercial relationships with suppliers, with a principal objective of achieving Amazon service and customer experience with improved cost and performance- Lead supplier performance management;

Our team strives to be THE control tower for 3PL EF procurement support to our stakeholders. title: Operations Business Partner
description:

Over the past three years, the LATAM team has significantly expanded its business and launched a global modernization program, introducing key organizational and methodological changes in Operations. To help navigate evolving priorities while maintaining our Business as Usual (BAU) commitments, we are seeking a dynamic and strategic leader to serve as aDirector,Operations Business Partner. This role, which sits within the Operations team, will act as the single point of contact for the Commercial team, represent the voice of Operations on local boards, and ensure clear assessment, prioritization, and ownership of business opportunities, quality incidents and revenue-strategic projects. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Operations in one of Worldpanel’s most dynamic and fast-evolving regions. As theOperations Business Partner, you will be at the center of strategic decision-making—serving as the critical link between Commercial and Operations. This role is essential to protecting revenue and ensuring data quality—two pillars of our client value proposition. You will ensure operational readiness for new business, enabling scalable growth and reducing risk in commercial execution. By safeguarding data quality and SLA compliance, you will directly impact client satisfaction, retention, and delivery excellence. As the single point of contact between Commercial and Operations, you will accelerate decision-making, resolve issues proactively, and drive alignment across teams. You will lead key regional projects, foster seamless cross-functional collaboration, and ensure that new business opportunities are both viable and sustainable. If you are passionate about transforming operations, influencing strategy, and delivering measurable impact, this role offers the platform, visibility, and leadership scope to make a lasting difference.Key Responsibilities Cluster Operations SPOC Act as the primary Operations representative for local commercial leaders. Strengthen and foster effective communication between commercial and Operations. Participate in local boards and leadership meetings to align operational priorities with business goals. Monitor, ensure and socialize compliance with SLAs. Ensure management, prioritization and resolution of critical client-impacting quality incidents within operations. Ensure internal (Worldpanel) and external (client) data quality requirements are met. Client Engagement Enablement Support Commercial by enabling Operations to actively participate in client conversations. Provide operational (technical) insights and solutions that enhance client satisfaction and deliver quality. Project Ownership & Execution Foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement within the Ops team. Lead and oversee key operational regional projects, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives. This includes project KPIs and metrics. Identify and remove roadblocks to accelerate project delivery and impact. Collaborate across the LATAM Operations team to ensure effective prioritisation and dependency management. New Business Evaluation Own the operational assessment for new business opportunities (e.G., new categories, attributes, or services). Collaborate with cross-functional teams to evaluate and implement scalable and sustainable solutions. Silo Effect Prevention Promote cross-functional collaboration to ensure shared ownership and impact assessment across departments. Ensure timely communication and coordination between local, regional and global Ops teams. Act as a connector between teams to prevent duplication of efforts and misalignment. Proactively address communication gaps to safeguard delivery commitments.Key stakeholders Regional Commercial Leaders and Commercial teams Regional and local Technology, Product. LATAM Operations Leadership Team LATAM Managing Director Regional and local Finance Directors Regional Data Acquisition LeadersSuccess Measures:
Timely and effective delivery of key regional and global operational projects, meeting defined KPIs and business impact goals. Enhanced client experience through operational support, proactive issue resolution, and improved data quality. Clear and actionable feasibility assessments for new business opportunities, enabling sustainable growth. Improved data quality (demonstrated by KPIs managed by the global data quality team). Delivery of Operations OGSPs linked to Operations.Skills, knowledge, and experience required:
Proven experience in operations leadership, business partnering, or strategic project management—preferably in a data-driven or technology-enabled environment. Strong understanding of operational processes, data quality standards, and client delivery in a service-based business. Proven experience in the management of complex, matrixed regional, teams and programmes Proven experience in prioritisation and change management in a complex, regional environment. Comfortable working to tight deadlines in a client-centric culture. Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders at all levels. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate complex operational topics into business-relevant insights. Experience working in a regional or multi-country context, ideally within LATAM. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on continuous improvement and impact delivery. Fluency in English and Spanish (written and spoken).Preferred:

title: Programme Manager - Building Future Generations
description:
TO APPLY, RESUMES MUST BE SUBMITTED IN ENGLISH. Automatic translations may present some mistakes, and we might not be able to properly evaluate your application. Company Description Porticus is a philanthropic organization that aims to create a just and sustainable future where human dignity flourishes. Our work aims to strengthen the resilience of communities so that all people have ownership over their future and natural resources are used in a sustainable way. Our work is realized through strong networks of partners including local and global NGOs, communities, people with lived experience, policy makers and co-funders. With colleagues based in 14 offices around the world in six regions, we want to provide solutions to today’s social and environmental problems that benefit generations to come in four areas:
the natural environment, society, education and faith. Job Description Porticus is seeking a Programme Manager to support and monitor the development of strategic programmes in the Latin America region within the the Building Future Generations Sector (BFG). The time dedication will be split between the Children on the Margins Challenge in Brazil and Peru (main priority), and the Knowledge Centre globally. The PM will also have a smaller portion of time dedicated to one of the topics covered by the Latin America Region. Building Future Generations Sector Strategy Vision:
A world where whole child development is a force for inclusion for children in extreme adversity, enabling them to develop to their full potential and succeed in life. Social Change Goal:
Children in extreme adversity build resilience and socio-emotional skills as a key enabler for them to learn and develop to their full potential. Porticus is fully committed to supporting the achievement of Sustainable Development Goal 4 – ‘Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all’ – by 2030. Our contribution to this has focused on supporting systems to integrate the principle and vision of Whole Child Development. We see resilience/ socio-emotional learning (SEL)/psycho-social support (PSS) as a critical building block, especially for children in extreme adversity who are often dealing with trauma and toxic stress, to enable engagement in meaningful learning and unlock opportunities for children to engage in the full breadth of education to fulfil their potential. Children on the Margin Challenge One in five children are thought to be “on the margin” of school systems, and 11% of children currently in school will drop-out before they reach the final grade. SEL is vital for all children, but especially for children who face fear, trauma and adversity – typically the children that education systems, despite good intentions, fail to support. Porticus’ Children on the Margins Challenge aspires to shift the mindsets and unequal power dynamics that normalise some children being on the margin of education systems, and to support the implementation of the tools and approaches that will nurture SEL. Porticus Latin America currently has programmatic work in education in Brazil and Peru. The programme in Brazil is in its first phase, while the programme in Peru is already on a second phase, based on learnings from the previous Horizontes Programme. In both countries, the geography prioritized is the Amazon region, with particular focus on children from indigenous, Quilombola or riverine origins, due to their historical neglect by the formal education system. Knowledge Center As part of our overall BFG strategy, Porticus is supporting a shared research fund to strengthen the evidence base on SEL in Foundational Learning. The goal is that more practical research is available to support practitioners, and a future Systematic Review addresses SEL at scale for Global South contexts, populations and needs. The Prorgamme Manager role for which we are hiring will have the responsibilities of:
Liaising with the external Programme Director and the administrative staff of the pooled fund to manage day to day relationships Supporting the BFG Sector Director and Challenge Leads as a sounding board for the strategic direction of the knowledge centre Lead on Porticus grant-management to the pooled fund Ensuring coordination between the BFG team and external Programme Director Region-specific philanthropy Besides the 4 Sectors which are global priorities, Porticus also supports contextually relevant topics. Currently the Latin American team is focused on Democratic Innovation, Climate Justice and Strategic Philanthropy. It is expected that the PM dedicates 20% of time for this work. Key Responsibilities Program implementation In collaboration with the Senior Programme Managers, develops and follows-up the implementation of grants that aim for systemic and lasting changes in alignment with the respective Challenge strategy. Applies meaningful participation approaches to the extent possible Grant making, from co-developing applications with prospective partners, to accompanying the implementing, monitoring progress against objectives and ensuring successful closure. Works closely with other areas of Porticus (such as Grant Operations, 360 Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning) to ensure all parts of the grantmaking – from grant approval, contract signing,

title: Business Development | Partner Program (Remoto)
description:
Sao Paulo, Sao Paulo, Brasil Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente. Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados. Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO. Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:
Own It:
Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio. Live the Ride:
Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado. No Bullshit:
Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos. Team Play:
Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso. The Reason:
O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega. Nascemos com a missão de construir Parcerias de longo prazo em conjunto com os principais negócios do mercado, focando em construir soluções de gestão que agreguem a nossa tecnologia financeira ao negócio do parceiro, ou seja, integrar os softwares de gestão de estabelecimentos e soluções disruptivas à nossa plataforma financeira Stone Co. Nossa área está no centro da estratégia da companhia, e, juntamente com nossos parceiros, iremos construir e entregar para nossos clientes todas as soluções necessárias para automatizar fluxos, diminuir processos operacionais, e ajudar o nosso cliente a vender ainda mais. Nossa missão é entregar a mesma inteligência já implementada em estabelecimentos de diversos países da América do Norte e Europa. Procuramos ir muito além de uma simples relação de negócio. Nos preocupamos com cada etapa, desde o primeiro contato de negócios com os gestores de um parceiro até a implementação no estabelecimento comercial. Executando da forma correta e com pessoas muito boas, alcançaremos o nosso objetivo, que é construir o maior programa de parcerias do Brasil, no qual parceiros tenham acesso a diversos benefícios através de uma tecnologia de ponta para empreendedores obstinados. Como é ser um(a) Business Development Nosso time trabalha com autonomia, liberdade e responsabilidade para construir uma relação próxima com os parceiros e ajudá-los a trazer novas soluções para seus clientes, a diferenciar o seu produto e, tornar-se cada vez mais competitivo - para juntos, transformarmos o mercado. Para isso, procuramos pessoas com perfil empreendedor, com alta energia, muita integridade e vontade de aprender. O interesse por novos negócios, serviços financeiros e tecnologia e produtos é essencial, visto que somos o elo que liga todos os produtos da StoneCo ao mercado de Software e soluções. Parcerias para você será um NEGÓCIO. Um negócio no qual você deverá construir relações com parceiros, desenvolvendo novos produtos e serviços, desde a ideação, o MVP até a fase de crescimento (escala) da parceria. Além de construir novas parcerias, você também irá gerir suas parcerias, entendendo todas as alavancas operacionais que impactam o negócio do parceiro e da Stone - além dos produtos tecnológicos mais adequados ao mercado do parceiro. É uma oportunidade única para desenvolver uma grande variedade de skills, desde a interação comercial, passando por assuntos de produtos e tecnologia, e desenvolvimento e ação de estratégias para players de diferentes setores da economia. Construção de novas parcerias:
você terá contato (prospectando ou tratando oportunidades que chegam até nós) com diretores, CEO’s e CTO’s de diversas empresas do mercado. Sua missão será engajar e conduzir cada parceiro para dentro do Stone Partner Program e também para as melhores estratégias da parceria;
Você será donode diversos parceiros, e isso exige hands-on. Seu parceiro será o seu negócio. Será necessário se envolver profundamente em cada etapa da jornada;
Terá que lidarcomproblemas complexos, e ter a capacidade de lidar com diversas variáveis como:
regulatório, jurídico, produto, negócios, dentre outros;
Terá que exercer um excelente julgamento de negócio, ou seja, ter capacidade e interesse para tomar decisões estratégicas e operacionais que impactam diretamente a área;
Terá um aprendizado constante sobre estratégias, vendas, produtos e tecnologia. Estes pilares são essenciais para nós. O que esperamos de você:
Buscamos gente muito boa, com perfil de construção, e que possuam desejo por multiplicar resultados para si, para o time e para a companhia. As oportunidades de crescimento são proporcionalmente iguais às entregas - e isso não é “bullshitagem”. Todos os nossos líderes passam por esta trilha. Além disso, existem alguns pontos importantes que levamos em consideração:
Espírito empreendedor Tenacidade comercial Entusiasmo para construir a parceria Experiência comercial com B2B Experiência de trabalho de +5 anos Ter trabalhado/conhecimento em produtos financeiros e digitais (tecnologia) Capacidade analítica para tomada de decisão, buscando implementar melhorias e mantendo altos padrões em suas entregas. Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar. Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos. E aí? Curtiu? title: Project Director, Conserving The Pantanal And Gran Chaco Wildlands
description:
Project Director, Conserving the Pantanal and Gran Chaco Wildlands The Environment Portfolio at The Pew Charitable Trusts For more than 30 years, Pew has been a major force in engaging the public and policy makers about the causes, consequences, and solutions to some of the world’s most pressing environmental challenges. Our environment work spans all seven continents with more than 250 professionals working at the local, national, and international levels to reduce the scope and severity of global environmental problems, such as the erosion of large natural ecosystems that contain a great part of the world’s remaining biodiversity, and the destruction of the marine environment. Pew’s global environmental program focuses on science-based, nonpartisan, and sustainable solutions to help protect the planet and people. Conserving the Pantanal and Gran Chaco Wildlands South America’s Pantanal and Gran Chaco regions are among the most ecologically significant tropical wetlands and dry forests on Earth. This area spans parts of Brazil, Bolivia, Paraguay, and Argentina and contains thousands of plant and animal species and provides vital aquatic habitat, nutrient renewal, migration routes, and flood control for millions of animals and people living downstream. The region’s extensive ecosystems are currently threatened by deforestation, drought and intensification of wildfires related to climate change, and thus urgently need conservation action. The project will work with the policy frameworks in each country to solidify and expand protection of the extraordinary biodiversity of the Pantanal-Gran Chaco region. Pew will partner with local and international conservation organizations, government agencies, and Indigenous governments and organizations to improve management of and expand protected areas, support Indigenous organizations and communities in the management of their territories, promote sustainable management for ranching lands, and to advance long-term conservation financing mechanisms for durable protections. Position Overview The Project Director, Pantanal-Gran Chaco Project, will develop and lead implementation of a project to mobilize support for durable conservation measures in order to maintain the ecosystems and biodiversity of the Pantanal Chaco region in close collaboration with partner organizations. The project director oversees a multi-country strategy working on large scale land and freshwater conservation in the Pantanal Chaco. This position manages staff in Bolivia, and relationships with consultants and partner organizations across Bolivia and Brazil with potential expansion to include Argentina and Paraguay. The position reports to the Senior Director, Land and Freshwater Conservation. The position is preferably based within one of the following locations:
Santa Cruz or La Paz, Bolivia;
Campo Grande, Cuiaba,or Sao Paulo, Brazil;
or elsewhere within orproximate to the Pantanal and Gran Chaco region. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country for which they are seeking employment without visa sponsorship. Responsibilities:
Foster a work environment that is diverse, equitable, inclusive, and accessible and in line with Pew and the project’s related goals. Develop and supervise implementation of effective project strategies and set achievable and measurable targets that will result in achieving the project’s goals to improve and enhance the protection of the Pantanal Chaco through the countries’ protected area systems, Indigenous territories, sustainably managed ranchlands, and other effective conservation measures. Supervise and support a distributed team of staff and consultants, in order to develop and maintain a highly motivated, well-resourced, and effective collective effort to achieve project goals. Identify capacity needs, including hiring staff and consultants, as necessary to ensure the project has the necessary human resources to achieve its goals. Coordinate closely with partners and other allies and organizations in order to maximize the impact of project strategies, facilitate the development of partnerships and coalitions as appropriate. Develop and maintain working relationships with decision makers, government officials and national and international institutions, as well as relevant NGOs in the field. description:
About World Business Lenders ( ) World Business Lenders (WBL) provides short-term, real estate collateralized commercial loans to small and medium-sized businesses across the United States that lack access to traditional funding. WBL manages its own loan portfolio and third-party portfolios, specializing in non-performing loan pools and REO. WBL is a U.S.-based company with a fully remote workforce. This is a remote contract/consultant position with working hours from 9:
00 am to 6:
00 pm Eastern Time, Monday through Friday. The role requires excellent command of written and spoken English. Resumes must be submitted in English. Position Summary The Asset Resolution Team Lead (also known as Case Management Team Lead) manages an assigned portfolio of distressed short-term, real estate collateralized commercial loans. They provide mentorship and support to Asset Resolution Analysts (ARAs), each managing their own distressed loan portfolios. The Team Lead is responsible for portfolio ownership, case analysis, recovery operations, and working with outside counsel to optimize asset resolution. Key responsibilities include developing and monitoring collection, loss mitigation, and recovery strategies in collaboration with outside counsel, managing case administration, analysis, and reporting. This leadership role requires managing a large asset portfolio, providing clear instructions to external parties, familiarity with legal proceedings (preferably in the U.S.), and financial analysis skills or experience in structured finance. Candidates should be comfortable with leadership duties and mentoring junior staff. Essential Functions Manage and monitor a non-performing real estate collateralized commercial loan portfolio. Develop, train, and supervise a team of Asset Resolution Analysts. Develop and update policies and procedures. Conduct pipeline management and financial analysis. Implement recovery strategies. Oversee litigation, bankruptcy, and foreclosure activities, including drafting and reviewing legal documents. Liaise with attorneys, collection agencies, and vendors. Engage with customers and their counsel for negotiations and conflict resolution. Maintain accurate case records. Prepare reports on case status, performance, outcomes, budgets, and forecasts. Collaborate on financial reporting, valuations, and legal strategies. Perform other duties as assigned. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent (preferred from U.S. institution). Paralegal Certificate or equivalent (preferred). Fluent in English, both written and verbal. Strong organizational, communication, and leadership skills. Knowledge of U.S. collection, foreclosure, bankruptcy laws, and legal processes. Knowledge of real property recording systems and titles (preferred). Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, financial analysis, and negotiation skills. Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. Detail-oriented, resourceful, with excellent follow-through. Proficient in Microsoft Office and Adobe applications. Ability to build effective internal and external relationships. Additional Details Contract/Consultancy position. PTO available. USD salary. 100% remote work from home. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Gerente De Negocios
description:
Job description Sobre a Rodobens:
Com mais de 70 anos no mercado, a Rodobens é um dos maiores grupos financeiros do Brasil e tem ajudado milhares de pessoas a tirarem seus planos do papel e realizarem seus sonhos, independentemente do tamanho deles. Contando com serviços de:
consórcio, empréstimo, concessionárias próprias, financiamentos, seguros, telemedicina, e-commerce pra peças de automóveis, locação de veículos pessoais e de veículos comerciais, a Rodobens tem cada vez mais colocado clientes como o centro de seus valores e prezado pela inovação e praticidade. Por que a Rodobens? Narrando uma história de conquistas desde 1949, a Rodobens está sediada em São José do Rio Preto, mas possui uma unidade de negócio em São Paulo e diversas concessionárias espalhadas por todo o Brasil. Aqui na Rodobens nós incentivamos que cada pessoa seja ela mesma. Acreditamos que diferentes visões e vivências são essenciais para o desenvolvimento da empresa e para a construção de um ambiente acolhedor. A Rodobens respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso com a diversidade. Saiba mais sobre a área de atuação Consórcio A Rodobens Consórcio é uma empresa com mais de 50 anos de experiência e a maior administradora independente do Brasil. Reúne tradição e pioneirismo em seu DNA:
foi responsável pelo primeiro consórcio de imóveis do Brasil e formação de grupos nacionais. Atua nos segmentos de automotores (automóveis, veículos comerciais e motos), imobiliário e serviços, com capacidade de formar grupos nacionais, apoiada em uma estrutura de mais de 2.500 pontos de venda. Desde sua fundação, é filiada à Associação Brasileira de Administradoras de Consórcios (Abac), cumprindo as exigências e determinações impostas pelo Banco Central do Brasil para atuar no setor. Tem como visão de negócio ser inovadora, eficiente e comprometida com os ideais e anseios de seus clientes e parceiros. Oferece mais do que produtos diferenciados e os meios mais econômicos e inteligentes de aquisição de bens e serviços, oferece também uma história de solidez e uma disposição permanente para a inovação, que estão expressos em uma palavra:
confiabilidade! Main responsibilities No dia a dia você irá:
Trabalhar na área comercial de consórcios, sendo responsável por expandir as operações comerciais da Rodobens em região pré-estabelecida, prospectando novos parceiros, criando e mantendo relacionamentos estratégicos e garantindo o cumprimento das metas pré-estabelecidas. Prospectar e identificar parceiros dispostos a comercializar os produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Rodobens (consórcios, seguros, refinanciamentos, entre outros). Atuar no planejamento e execução de estratégias comerciais para alavancar resultados na região. Desenvolver um pipeline consistente de novos negócios com clientes destes parceiros. Manter e fortalecer estes relacionamentos com clientes e parceiros, promovendo uma experiência de atendimento excepcional. Garantir o alcance das metas comerciais e de faturamento, bem como o alinhamento às diretrizes estratégicas da Rodobens. Monitorar indicadores de desempenho e reportar os resultados à liderança. Representar a Rodobens em eventos, reuniões e negociações, atuando como embaixador da marca. Zelar pela imagem institucional da empresa, promovendo seus pilares e valores sempre compromissado com a excelência. Requirements and skills Para participar do nosso processo você precisa ter:
Escolaridade:
Ensino superior completo;
Conhecimento necessário:
Pacote Office intermediário, domínio da ferramenta excel;
Técnicas de Negociação.Habilidades:
Comunicação, Proatividade, Trabalho em Equipe, Gestão Comercial e desenvoltura para falar em público;
Prospecção de novos parceiros;
Veículo próprio edisponibilidade para viagens;
Será um diferencial:
Experiência comercial com vendas externas. Additional information Local de trabalho:

title: Energy Program Director
description:
Prologis, Inc. is the global leader in logistics real estate. In partnership with our customers and our communities, we develop modern, high-quality properties that set the standard for innovative building design and sustainability. Prologis owns or has investments in properties and development projects of ~1.2 billion square feet in 19 countries and enables 2.8% of the world’s GDP. We have committed to achieve net zero emissions by 2040. Beyond real estate, our Essentials platform optimizes the company’s global asset portfolio to provide our customers solutions that address today’s warehouse and shipping challenges. Prologis Ventures invests in logistics innovation and technology companies to modernize supply chains worldwide. Job Title:
Energy Program DirectorCompany:
Prologis A day in the life Prologis is seeking an ambitious and passionate Energy Program Director / Vice President in Brasil to manage our growing portfolio of energy supply and renewable energy projects. We own over 5,000 buildings across the globe and over 400 buildings in Brasil which provides a huge opportunity for bundling energy and optimizing supply and demand solutions for our customers. The candidate has experience managing the implementation of energy projects, preferably on-site solar, plus deep knowledge of the Brasil electricity market. Experience with electricity and renewable energy contracts, energy management, and overall energy project solutions at facilities is highly valued. Anything we can do to help solve customer needs or monetize our unparalleled holdings is in play. We are investing in projects, growing our team, and expanding our commitment to energy and sustainability solutions globally. You will report to the Global Head of Sustainability and EU/LATAM Energy and will play a meaningful role as part of a top-notch team of global energy and sustainability professionals who are driving value for Prologis. Preferred experience also includes raising of investment capital for energy projects. Key responsibilities include:
Lead the implementation of an innovative renewable energy strategy focused on providing solutions for Prologis customers to utilize 100% renewable electricity Work with Prologis stakeholders and external parties to build out and scale up the implementation of on-site solar projects as well as qualified supply in collaboration with third party providers. Lead the transition of electricity supply to 100% renewable by creating a customer value proposition and enrollment process for both Prologis managed and non-managed (i.E., customer managed meters) focused on financial and sustainability value. Collaborate on development of energy management services for customers and contribute to offer development and rollout of various new initiatives in Brasil in collaboration with Real Estate Customer Experience (RECx) teams, Global Energy Supply leader, and other constituents Project manage third party suppliers providing associated services in engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) of solar systems, qualified supply contract management, customer billing and administration, ongoing operations & maintenance and any other related tasks Manage contractual relationships and coordinate with legal, as needed, to assist with contract negotiations and to resolve programmatic needs/requirements Follow energy regulatory frameworks and assess the impact of potential changes on existing power contracts and new leads. Interface and develop strong working relationships with various regional internal and external partners to ensure the Energy and Sustainability team brings value to our real estate business Provide routine reporting on program KPIs and implementation, financial, and operating metrics Preferred additional responsibilities include:
Partner with EMS Finance and Capital Formation and varied investment banking partners to structure a take-out capital fund for Energy investments, raise capital to support deployment and stabilization of Brazil energy assets Building blocks for success Required:
Bachelor's degree or higher 10+ years of experience in energy markets, energy trading, power contract negotiations, energy regulations, renewable development, or energy generation technologies Strong understanding of electricity market design, federal and state regulatory rules and issues, tariff structures, renewable energy, and environmental commodities Proficiency in both Spanish and English languages in verbal and written formats Proven ability to negotiate commercial pricing, contract terms, and other key terms Full knowledge and understanding of the Brasil Energy market and associated regulatory / law frameworks Experience building relationships and working with industry stakeholders, such as retail suppliers / load serving entities, utilities, regional power planning agencies, and renewable OEMs Knowledge of energy management strategies ranging from data collection and management to decarbonization solutions such as energy efficiency, renewables, and offsets. Demonstrated ability to innovate and get creative to develop executable projects A history of collaboration, problem solving and communication that drives overall team success Able to travel up to 25% of the time (largely to Rio de Janeiro) Preferred:
Proven experience in investment banking and capital raising, including deal structuring and investor engagement People First As a successful global enterprise, Prologis has never lost sight of what matters most - our strong belief that our people are the most important part of our business. And because of that, we provide a generous total rewards package and dedicate both time and resources to leadership development.Our team is intentional about cultivating a culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion so that everyone at Prologis feels a sense of belonging. title: Regional Director, Latam São Paulo, Brazil
description:
Interested in working on cutting-edge blockchain technology and creating equitable access to the global financial system? Since 2014, the mission-driven team at the Stellar Development Foundation (SDF) has helped fuel the tremendous growth of the Stellar blockchain network, an open-source platform that operates at high-scale today. Developers and companies around the world build on it, and the SDF team is expanding to support the rapidly growing and changing Stellar ecosystem. We are looking for a seasoned Regional Director to help drive business development efforts across LATAM for SDF. The person in this role will serve as a key regional public-facing voice and thought leader helping to educate and inform the region about the Stellar ecosystem. This person will further create organizational efficiency by assisting with coordination of all SDF activity in that area - from business development focused on developers up through large regional financial institutions, to event representation and planning, to policy and regulatory initiatives. They will support the broader partnership team and company objectives, and will be close partners and shared owners of all primary OKRs. In this role, your responsibilities will include:
Business development work related to our core priorities on expanding DeFi, increasing monthly addresses, and driving asset tokenization, in coordination with Leads of each partnership vertical to drive relevant outcomes. These include surfacing opportunities based on SDF's needs, as well as helping to close deals brought by other members of BD and SDF. Assisting on regulatory and government relations needs in region, helping support the Legal, Policy and Government Relations teams. Assisting the Ecosystem team to identify, plan, and run events in region. You have:
10+ years of relevant experience with a proven track record of success in business development roles within the blockchain, fintech, or financial services industries. A minimum of 2 years of experience in the blockchain industry, either at a blockchain company or in a role working on blockchain technology and use cases. Strong understanding of the cryptocurrency landscape and experience working with crypto exchanges, custodians, and asset tokenization platforms. A high degree of accountability with STRONG ability to communicate regional progress and all outcomes at frequent intervals to stakeholders. Ability to work in a collaborative team environment, with multiple stakeholders, while often working remotely from said team. Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to develop and maintain professional relationships with a network of senior-level professionals, as well as sound judgment, poise in professional settings, and self-awareness. Self-starter with an entrepreneurial drive. The ability to travel as needed, with frequent representation of Stellar at regional meetings and conferences. Bonus points if you have:
Existing relationships within the crypto ecosystem, particularly with a focus on tokenization and decentralized finance. Existing relationships with financial institutions, particularly on the asset management side. We offer competitive pay for this position depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition, we offer lumen-denominated grants along with other perks and benefits. We look forward to hearing from you! About the Stellar Development Foundation The Stellar Development Foundation (SDF) is a non-profit organization focused on working with and supporting changemakers to create equitable access to the global financial system through blockchain technology. SDF provides grants, investments, funding, and other awards to builders and organizations. SDF also develops resources and tooling on the Stellar network to help unlock real-world utility. As a nonprofit foundation, SDF puts the health of the Stellar network and the Stellar ecosystem and its mission above all else. SDF is committed to diversity in its workforce and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. SDF does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state or federal law. #J-18808-Ljbffr

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade. Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. title: Coordenador Estratégia Aquisição Rentabilização Pme
description:

Somos multicampeões confirmado pelo Speedtest como Internet móvel mais rápida e estável e com rede wi-fi mais estável do Brasil, entre tantos outros reconhecimentos. Também somos a 5º marca mais valiosa do Brasil (BrandZ).Estamos presentes em mais de 4.800 municípios, somando mais de 83 milhões de clientes. Lideramos o saldo de portabilidade há mais de 5 anos.E tem mais:
inovamos nossos produtos e serviços para atender cada vez melhor nossos usuários! Por isso, hoje, contamos com soluções de entretenimento (Claro música, Claro tv+, Claro livros, Claro vídeo e Claro gaming), finanças (Claro pay) e muito mais! Temos presença aeroespacial (com 5 satélites em órbita pela Embratel) e somos referência em conectividade industrial, automotiva, agronegócio e outros. Também temos um ambiente de conexão entre nossos negócios e o ecossistema de inovação, que é o beOn, o hub de inovação da Claro e Embratel.Sustentabilidade é um valor para a Claro. Investimos no desenvolvimento ambiental, economico e social, prezando sempre pela governança, responsabilidade ambiental, proteção de dados e impacto social. Por meio do Instituto Claro, conectamos pessoas para um futuro melhor, aliando os serviços prestados a investimentos sociais em projetos de educação e cidadania.E aí, deu match? Vem pra Claro construir o novo com a gente!Como será o seu dia a dia?Conduzir a evolução da atuação comercial da Claro Empresas, com foco na definição e gestão da estratégia de aquisição e rentabilização de clientes, a partir do desenho de modelos operacionais, políticas comerciais e diretrizes estratégicas aderentes ao perfil de cliente B2B, à vocação dos canais e à estratégia da companhia.Liderar a definição e a atualização contínua da estratégia de atuação dos canais de vendas da Claro Empresas — incluindo canais diretos (D2D Próprio, TOP, Inside Sales) e indiretos (AACE, D2D Terceiros) — garantindo coerência com o perfil de consumo do cliente, capilaridade geográfica e objetivos de crescimento.Desenvolver e implementar políticas de gestão de base que orientem o trabalho dos canais de relacionamento e de farming, visando o aumento da penetração de soluções, a ampliação do ARPU e o crescimento sustentável da carteira.Estruturar e gerir os modelos de comissionamento e incentivo dos canais, assegurando alinhamento entre esforço e resultado, sustentabilidade financeira da operação e estímulo à produtividade. Responsável pelas políticas de metas, campanhas de vendas, programas de excelência e mecanismos de monitoramento da performance comercial.Propor e garantir a implantação de diretrizes que promovam a integração entre canais, evitando sobreposição de atuação, lacunas de cobertura e promovendo uma experiência unificada ao cliente. Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 paísesNo Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:
2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.Como nosso Gerente de Produto, você irá:

title: Sr. Product Manager - Privacy Team
description:
About the Role Our goal is to make Uber the industry model for consumer privacy through products and services, standards in product, engineering, policy, and transparent communications. We are seeking a Product Manager with strong consumer product sense, design intuition, and an entrepreneurial spirit. It is essential this person has experience working in uncharted territory as we build these unique privacy technologies and grow user trust. We need your skills and enthusiasm to make it happen! This PM will sit at the intersection of Law, Policy, Business and Engineering to ensure we holistically consider the regulatory environment and market landscape around privacy. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to build experiences across all products at Uber and make a significant global impact! --- What the Candidate Will Do ---- Define product requirements that factor in user needs, legal requirements, the policy landscape and business strategy. Ship consumer products against the Privacy Engineering team’s roadmap, and collaborate with other Product and Engineering teams where vital. Align stakeholders in Legal, Policy and Communications Strategy on a product-level mission and roadmap that builds trust with our users. Heavily apply data insights, market and customer research, and your product intuition to continually improve your products. Seek opportunities for new consumer products that bring to bear Uber's global scale and build upon its Privacy infrastructure to provide outstanding and lasting customer value. Clearly communicate plans, insights, data and results to a spectrum of audiences while defining and tracking privacy metrics.
---- Basic Qualifications ---- Minimum of 4 years Product Management experience delivering highly successful solutions within a tech company. Bachelors degree in computer science or similar engineering (Master's preferred). Direct experience with the user and technical challenges faced in Privacy, Trust & Safety or Risk engineering and product teams.
---- Preferred Qualifications ---- Depth, expertise, and pragmatism:
You are a visionary for user privacy and can apply them in a business environment. Passion:
You’re excited and equipped to share our message on privacy and data protection to our users, the industry, and other experts. You may have given public talks or published blog posts or papers on technical topics. Leadership:
You’re able to educate partners on the privacy impact of product decisions and ensure innovation and data protection coexist. You’re just as comfortable with on the ground privacy challenges as you are driving strategy with executive leadership. A great teammate:

title: Project Buyer
description:
Bring more to life. Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology? At Pall Corporation, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact. You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life. As a global leader in high-tech filtration, separation, and purification, Pall Corporation thrives on helping our customers solve their toughest challenges. Our products serve diverse, global customer needs across a wide range of applications to advance health, safety and environmentally responsible technologies. From airplane engines to hydraulic systems, scotch to smartphones, OLED screens to paper—everyday Pall is there, helping protect critical operating assets, improve product quality, minimize emissions and waste, and safeguard health. For the exponentially curious, Pall is a place where you can thrive and amplify your impact on the world. Find what drives you on a team with a more than 75-year history of discovery, determination, and innovation. Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible. The Project Buyer is responsible for ensuring the procurement of goods and services for specific projects, including international sourcing and import activities. This role involves sourcing, negotiating, selecting and managing supplier relationships to ensure the timely and cost-effective delivery of high-quality materials and services. This role involves coordinating import activities, managing documentation, and ensuring compliance with international trade regulations. This position reports to the Procurement & Strategic Sourcing Manager Latam and is part of the Supply Chain team located in Diadema-SP and will be an on-site role. In this role, you will have the opportunity to:
Project Coordination:
Collaborate with project managers and other stakeholders to ensure procurement activities align with project timelines and objectives. Supplier Analysis:
Identify and evaluate potential suppliers, negotiate contracts, build relationships with suppliers to ensure project requirements are met to secure the best pricing and terms. Contract Management:
Ensure compliance with contractual terms and conditions, and negotiate changes as needed to align with project needs. Cost Reduction:
Drive cost reduction initiatives and process improvement projects to enhance efficiency and reduce expenses. Process Improvement:
Identify and implement strategies to streamline import processes and reduce costs. The essential requirements of the job include:
Bachelor’s degree in:
Business, Supply Chain, International Relations, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in import operations in procurement or a related role, working in all aspects of import activities, customs clearance, documentation, and compliance with international trade regulations. Fluent in English, with excellent communication and negotiation skills. Track record of analysing supplier data to identify cost-saving opportunities and process improvements, while handling issues like delays and discrepancies. Experience inproviding reports on project status, supplier performance and purchasing activities, including cost analyses and inventory status. It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:
Analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team with strong organizational and time management skills. Attention to detail and accuracy with excellent communication and negotiation skills Pall Corporation, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info. Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life. For more information, visit. title: Trainee - Production Management
description:
Trainee - Production Management (m/f/x) first in our headquarters near Osnabrück, followed by São Paulo, Brazil For more than 140 years, AMAZONE has been developing high tech for the agricultural world. Day after day, customers from over 70 countries rely on AMAZONE machines to harvest the best possible results. This is how we make a decisive contribution to the global food supply. At MP AGRO, a subsidiary of AMAZONE located in Ibaté, São Paulo, Brazil, you will work at a company recognized for its exceptional innovation, high quality, and expertise in advanced and sustainable fertilizer technology. Founded in 2012, MP AGRO has established itself as a trusted name in the Brazilian market, specializing in the development, production, and distribution of cutting-edge solutions for precision and sustainability in agriculture. Your training / This is what you move with us Join our international trainee program AmazoneFuture and lay the foundation for your career in production management. Over the course of 18 months, you will gain practical experience in various key departments, including production planning, production control, and quality management, giving you a comprehensive understanding of production processes. This rotation across different areas ensures you develop a well-rounded skill set and deep insights into modern production practices. Your journey will primarily take place at our German headquarters, where you will work closely with experienced teams and gain valuable hands-on experience. Additionally, a planned assignment at MP AGRO in Brazil will provide you with international exposure, allowing you to understand the dynamics of a global organization and experience the local market firsthand. What makes this program special? It’s more than just a learning opportunity – it’s a chance to grow both professionally and personally. With the guidance of a personal mentor, tailored training sessions, and project-based learning, you’ll enhance your technical expertise and gain practical knowledge that will prepare you for an exciting role at MP AGRO in Brazil. Upon successful completion of the program, a promising position awaits you at MP AGRO in Brazil, where you’ll play a key role in driving our mission to deliver sustainable and cutting-edge agricultural technology. Your qualifications / This is what you bring with you Educational background:
A degree in mechanical engineering, production, industrial engineering, or a related field, with a focus on manufacturing or industry. Practical experience:
Initial exposure to production management through internships, part-time jobs, or project work. Language skills:
Fluent English is essential;
German skills arean advantage. Global mindset:
Willingness to travel internationally and collaborate across cultures. Key competencies:
Proactive mindset, strong analytical skills, and enthusiasm for innovation and sustainable production. Your benefits / This is what we offer Attractive compensation package High takeover chances Short decision paths Personal development Your new employer / This is AMAZONE What began in 1883, we are now carrying on in the fourth generation:
Together with over 2,500 employees, we develop innovative agricultural machinery and technologies. Every day, we work at over 9 locations to further optimize the performance and user-friendliness of our products. We set high standards for quality and ongoing development in every department. Our corporate culture is characterized by cooperation and our shared success. With individual career paths, the AmaTrain personnel development program and a strong drive for innovation, we not only keep our company on course for growth, but also ensure a successful future for every single employee at AMAZONE.

description:
A AegeaCriada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.Programa Respeito dá o TomO programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.Responsabilidades:
Desenvolver e implementar padrões técnicos para automação e sensoriamento, assegurando consistência e eficiência nos processos.Revisar e aprovar projetos de automação das unidades operacionais, garantindo conformidade com diretrizes técnicas e objetivos estratégicos.Coordenar equipes e projetos de grande porte, garantindo entregas dentro dos prazos, padrões de qualidade e orçamento estabelecido.Prestar consultoria técnica para as unidades operacionais, promovendo melhores práticas e soluções avançadas de automação.Identificar e propor inovações tecnológicas para aprimorar os processos de automação e sensoriamento.Desenvolver e revisar lógicas de controle para CLPs Siemens e Schneider, além de especificar sensores e instrumentos conforme diretrizes estabelecidas.Requisitos:
Formação em Engenharia de Controle e Automação e/ou Engenharia Elétrica.Experiência sólida com CLPs Siemens e Schneider, incluindo programação e desenvolvimento de lógica de controle.Conhecimento avançado em redes de comunicação industrial.Experiência em gestão de projetos e liderança de equipes.Inglês intermediário.Disponibilidade para viagens recorrentes às unidades da Aegea.Benefícios:
Assistência médica;
Assistência odontológica;
Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
Seguro de vida;

Gympass;
Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
Participação nos Lucrose Resultados;
Kit office.Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +760 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Commercial Coordinator
description:
1. About usKeeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief:

Assist Keeta in establishing a food delivery sales team in new cities, starting from scratch to drive business expansion. Prioritize talent growth, having previously served as a corporate trainer or established a training system within the team.Motivation and Resilience :
Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.Language Proficiency :
Fluent in English and Portuguese (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work and travel.4. Job HighlightsJoin us to witness the rapid growth of Meituan's global food delivery business and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. title: Especialista De Mercado
description:
Inteligência Estratégica para Suprimentos CAPEX Responsabilidades principais:
Liderar e executar análises de mercado com foco em grandes contratações (equipamentos, obras, infraestrutura, engenharia, etc.). Mapear e analisar drivers de mercado, como câmbio, inflação, commodities, custos logísticos, disponibilidade de fornecedores, tendências setoriais e geopolíticas. Elaborar e validar modelos de cost breakdown (decomposição de custos) para categorias de alto impacto. Fornecer inteligência estratégica para definição de estratégias de sourcing, negociação e planejamento orçamentário. Conduzir benchmarkings nacionais e internacionais, estudando práticas de mercado e alternativas técnicas e comerciais. Atuar em sinergia com áreas de engenharia, planejamento, compras e projetos para construção de estratégias de contratação mais eficientes. Apoiar o desenvolvimento de business cases e proposições de mercado com base em evidências. Monitorar riscos de mercado e propor mitigações ou oportunidades de atuação proativa. Formação e experiência desejada:
Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. MBA ou especializações em Supply Chain, Inteligência de Mercado, Finanças ou Engenharia de Custos são diferenciais. Experiência sólida (mínimo 5 anos) em inteligência de mercado, suprimentos estratégicos ou áreas similares, preferencialmente com foco em CAPEX. Experiência em setores como papel e celulose, mineração, energia, óleo e gás, agronegócio, infraestrutura ou indústria de base será um diferencial. Conhecimentos e habilidades técnicas:
Excel e Power BI avançados (obrigatório). SAP, Ariba ou outras ferramentas de procurement. Conhecimentos de modelos de TCO (Total Cost of Ownership), análises econômicas e de viabilidade. Fluência em inglês será um diferencial relevante. Atuação no segmento de celulose será um diferencial.

title: Consultor(A) Estrategia Digital I
description:
Job DescriptionQUEM SOMOS?Prazer, somos a Suzano!Aqui a gente acredita que inovação e sustentabilidade caminham juntas. Dessa união, nasce uma atitude plena de significado:
a inovabilidade. Pautados por ela, pensamos fora da caixa e enxergamos longe para lidar com os desafios do século 21. Nós plantamos e cultivamos árvores para transformar essa matéria-prima renovável em Bioprodutos para o dia a dia de mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas. Cultivamos a vida na folha do caderno que alfabetiza as crianças, na fralda que protege os bebês, no copo de café que não prejudica o meio ambiente, em papéis absorventes e na comodidade do uso de uma embalagem sustentável.PLURALIguais e diferentes. Aqui você pode descobrir novos desafios, novos horizontes, novos objetivos e até mais sobre si mesmo!Responsibilities and assignmentsDadosGS16Local:

Há um alto nível de complexidade, pois lidamos com diversas unidades de negócio da Suzano, atendendo e conectando com as áreas distintas na companhia. Nosso desafio é liderar as demandas de transformação digital e propor soluções inovadoras com foco nos objetivos estratégicos da empresa e com visão de curto, médio e longo prazo.O profissional se juntará à nova área do Centro Digital da Suzano, criada para desenvolver soluções inovadoras de forma ágil com a missão de transformação do negócio em todos os níveis:
florestal, industrial, supply-chain, comercial e funções de suporte. Este profissional sênior desempenha um papel fundamental na concepção e implementação de soluções inovadoras, alinhadas aos objetivos e desafios estratégicos da organização. Com profunda experiência em consultoria estratégica e business design, o Estrategista Digital também será responsável por direcionar a estratégia digital da empresa, integrando oportunidades tecnológicas às metas de transformação do negócio alinhando e acompanhando as métricas de sucesso junto à alta liderança.Visão Criativa/analíticaAtuar como consultor interno, identificando e analisando tendências tecnológicas para alinhar soluções inovadoras aos objetivos de negócios, utilizando conhecimento em tecnologia;

Experiência comprovada em facilitação de workshops.Requirements And QualificationsQUEM NOS INSPIRA?Alguém que acredite em nossos valores;
Com iniciativa;
Perfil analítico;
Que proponha ideias esoluções.O QUE A SUZANO ESPERA DE VOCÊ?Inglês avançado/ fluente;
Alta habilidadenaconstrução de apresentações executivas em Power Point;
Experiência na utilização da ferramenta Miro;
Experiência comprovada com discovery de produtos digitais e atuação com times de tecnologia multidisciplinares.Additional informationNÓS TEMOS MUITO MAIS QUE UM PAPEL NA SUA VIDA!Cuidados da sua saúde:
Plano Médico, Odonto e Seguro de Vida;
VR ou Refeitório,VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado e, no final do ano, VA adicional;

Praticamos o homeoffice em áreas corporativas, a flexibilidade de horários, além do dress code casual;
