title: Coordenador De Compras/Cmv - Sp
description: Desenvolver e implementar um processo de compras adequado ao grupo, considerando as necessidades e particularidades de cada operação, desde o pedido até o recebimento e armazenamento das mercadorias. Desenvolver e implementar processos de controle, organização e gestão de estoque, incluindo requisições, fichas de prateleiras, organização por códigos de produtos e PEPs. Revisar e organizar o cadastro de todos os insumos e suas categorias, garantindo a correta classificação. Assegurar contagens de inventário precisas, revisando, auditando e implantando contagens semanais em alinhamento com os gestores de todos os setores (cozinha, bar e adega). Garantir ausência de divergências de estoque, alinhando estratégias com gestores, chefs, líderes de setores e nutricionista para controle de produção, rendimento e desperdício. Treinar, capacitar, qualificar e supervisionar as equipes envolvidas nos processos. Monitorar variações de preços, especialmente dos itens da curva ABC, e negociar preços estáveis, evitando rupturas e mantendo a qualidade. Cumprir metas orçamentárias e principais budgets, apresentando relatórios mensais com KPIs. Ajustar categorias de insumos e montar sistemas de requisição e controle de estoque por família e categoria. Estruturar compras com base na curva ABC, controlar movimentação diária, definir estoques máximos e mínimos, e apresentar KPIs de desempenho. Gerenciar fornecedores, avaliando desempenho, planejando aquisições, aumentando prazos de pagamento, evitando rupturas e garantindo entregas pontuais, além de estabelecer acordos e SLAs. Planejar compras, controlar estoque, assegurar qualidade e compliance, além de apresentar KPIs relacionados a custos, lead time, cumprimento de fornecedores e economia. Montar planos de ação para controle diário dos principais produtos de venda, analisar vendas versus compras semanalmente, e formalizar contratos com fornecedores principais para melhorar custos e retorno financeiro. title: Sr Vm Health & Personal Care, Br Stores - Retail Consumables
description:
Sr VM Health & Personal Care, BR Stores - Retail ConsumablesAmazon Brazil is looking for a dynamic senior vendor manager to play an important role within the Retail team by adding selection, analyzing business data, driving vendor performance, negotiating terms and handling promotions. As a senior vendor manager, you will report to the head of vendor management and be responsible for leading a team of vendor managers and developing relationships with several of our key vendors and partners. You will work with Brazilian and global vendors to drive all aspects of terms improvements, which includes analysis and projections, as well as direct negotiations with decision makers in local vendors. Additionally, you will increase product category sales by driving store marketing promotions, negotiating partners to improve selection, and reacting to industry-related economic trends.You will have excellent verbal and written communication, the ability to analyze and communicate complex terms and margin structure, and work well across other teams including Finance and Inventory Management. Candidates who are organized, flexible, creative, analytical, and able to drive negotiations through completion will be highly appreciated. Strong ownership values, a real passion for innovation, and hustle are also key to succeed in this position.If you are passionate about e-commerce and career growth, this opportunity with Amazon.Com.Br is for you!Key job responsibilitiesRetail Managers focus on and act at the intersection of customers, vendors, and functional teams:
CUSTOMERS:
They rely on specialized teams for customer and category information and insights, and work with and influence other teams to get the category-specific customer needs addressed. The Retail Manager is responsible for holding category-specific knowledge about customers and their needs, emerging product trends, market segment evolution, and new business opportunities.VENDORS:
RM are the ultimate owners of the vendor relationship, with a direct focus on the top vendors that drive the vast majority of sales. They are directly responsible for auditing and escalating performance, improving overall terms and cost structures of the relationship through negotiation, and for developing long-term partnerships with new and existing vendors to drive topline and selection fueling category growth.CENTRAL AND FUNCTIONAL TEAMS:
As a business owner, the RM represents customer and business needs in interaction with central teams, projects, and initiatives. The Retail Manager drives central teams for the evolution of customer-facing and internal systems to improve the customer experience from the category perspective. At the same time, they implement centrally driven initiatives within the category to drive CX or cost improvements, prioritizing based on impact and potential tradeoffs, and if needed, pushing back on selected initiatives.A day in the lifeRetail Managers are owners of the Retail business. Either for subcategories or a subgroup of vendors, they own the respective business end-to-end including the entire P&L, from topline down to free cash flow. They manage inputs by driving selection, securing great prices, and increasing convenience/speed to accelerate Amazon’s flywheel. While they focus their activities on our most strategically relevant vendors and holdouts, they audit and escalate the performance of lower-tiered vendors.BASIC QUALIFICATIONSStrong written and oral communication skills in English and Portuguese;
Experience in strategy,consultancy, financial analysis, category management,

title: Mkt-On-Site Account Manager - São Paulo, Brazil
description:
Job Summary:
This position is responsible for driving the business development and brand promotion of the company’s brands (including HP, Acer, Predator, Lenovo) across multiple markets such as the Asia-Pacific region, the Middle East, and Europe. The candidate must possess strong channel development capabilities and market insight, be able to independently plan sales strategies, cultivate local clients, and expand potential business opportunities to achieve the company’s performance and profit goals.Main Responsibilities:
Brand Product Sales & Promotion:
Responsible for the sales and brand management of HP-branded SSD and DRAM products in various markets;
Promote sales of Acer and Predator dual-brand SSD/DRAM/memory card products;
Develop Lenovo-branded SSD business to increase brand market share and visibility.Market & Customer Development:
Actively explore potential business opportunities, including new clients, channels, distribution partners, projects, and bidding opportunities;
Understand regional market characteristics and industry trends, and formulate corresponding sales strategies.Customer Relationship & Maintenance:
Maintain good communication and cooperation with existing clients, assist in solving sales and technical issues, and enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty;
Regularly collect localmarket intelligence and propose constructive suggestions and strategic adjustments.Sales & Profit Achievement:
Responsible for formulating and executing quarterly and annual sales plans to ensure achievement of sales and gross margin targets;
Analyze sales data, track performance, and manage budgets.Channel & Regional Operations:
Familiarity with one or more of the following market channels is a plus:
Indonesia, the Philippines, Japan, South Korea, Thailand, the Middle East, Europe, etc.;
Establish and maintain good cooperation with local agents, distributors, and retailers to enhance brand coverage.Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree or above, majoring in International Trade, Marketing, Information Technology, Electronics, or related fields is a plus;
At least 3 years of experience in international business or brand channel sales, preferably with a background in IT hardware or storage product sales;
Familiarity with SSD, DRAM, memory card product features and markets is preferred;
Good command of Englishin listening, speaking, reading, and writing, able to communicate fluently with international clients;
Proactive, with excellent negotiation and problem-solving skills, able to work independently and adapt to cross-cultural work environments;
Willing to travel overseas occasionally to support business expansion needs.

inovamos nossos produtos e serviços para atender cada vez melhor nossos usuários! obsessão pelos nossos clientes, competir para ganhar, desafiar o (seu) nosso pensamento, agir rápido e aprender rápido e juntos somos mais fortes.Impacto Social:
